name: qkd_ahub_g2c-c1-COMMIT
purpose: KV-AHUB3 FALLBACK (parallel to qkd_ahub_g2l): the same flat hub on ONE centre-fed spine (a7 clocking, which passed the tile clock rule 28.2/34.0) with the landings latency as registered relays ZW_RLY = ZR_RLY = 3 (landed=false); same calendar law HUB_RECIP/PUB +6

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_ahub_static_dw_g2 #(.ZW_RLY(3), .ZR_RLY(3)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/qkd_ahub_static_dw_g2.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/qkd_ahub_static_dw_safe.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_core.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_nhb_tiles_bb.v rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_recip_leaf_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: ahub_g2c_m0
bench.pass_regex: ^AHUB_DW PASS mut=0 passes=7 Z_IN_STRIDE=4 zwords=680 .* FR_OFS=-7 AP_OFS=ffd9ffdaffd8ffd8

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_g2c/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_g2c/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_g2c --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_ahub_static_dw_g2 --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_nhb_zh_m5/views/ot_nhb_zh --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkh_recip_ref/views/ot_qkh_recip_leaf > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: NEW kit (KV-AHUB3 10-19): FALLBACK twin of qkd_ahub_g2l (PARALLEL rule): qkd_ahub_static_dw_g2 on one common clock, with the landed form latency as 3 registered relay stages on each core <-> Z tree bus (ZW_RLY = ZR_RLY = 3: every > 405 um leg registered), a7 spine clocking. Bind whichever closes first under the checklist; cancel the loser.
